title: Multipole splats for optimized and inverted effective potentials
summary: In modern density functional theory, effective Hamiltonians are constructed to reproduce densities and forces of electrons at equilibrium. However, their nonlocal potentials leave systematic errors in spectral properties and real-time dynamics. Access to local optimized or inverted effective potentials would remove this limitation, but the numerical fragility in finite orbital bases has long prevented their wide adoption.
